family_descriptions.loss: Pure photon loss (paper amplitude-damping Kraus) after each UER/SNAP layer. Phase-covariant. Oracle binomial kernel.
family_descriptions.loss_thermal_dephasing: Lindblad cavity loss with nth=0.05 and number dephasing κ_φ τ = 0.5 κτ. Phase-covariant; heating spoils η^k moment scaling.
family_descriptions.comprehensive: Device-like: Lindblad loss (nth=0.01), transmon T1/T2, cavity self-Kerr, 1% ECD-amplitude and rotation errors. Not phase-covariant.
